summary: Correct and current, but the top nine are the football powers anyone names, so a casual player gets 9 of 10 and only the Soviet Union takes thought. Fine for free play, too easy for Today's list.
reasons: Casual player found 9/10: the eight football powers by reflex, then the Netherlands after Croatia and Belgium. A soccer-light player who opens with USA and Mexico also gets 9. That is past the 6-8 bar.
Curve is nearly all gimmes: the list plays as 'name the big football nations' and knowing the Ballon d'Or barely matters. The Soviet Union (#10) is the one stretch; the fan found all 10 for 2 lives.

Data matches Wikipedia's wins-by-country table, current through Harry Kane's 2026 win (England 6). West Germany, Holland, USSR, UK and the demonyms all land; Russia is free; Croatia and Ukraine are fair #11 near misses showing 1 win.
It has been in random free play since Oct 29, and the owner wants dailies fresh.
fixes: Misses on countries with no winner (Belgium, Uruguay, Poland, USA) read "Belgium is outside the top 11. Lost a life.": all ten extras tie at #11, so this hides the real point, that no Belgian has ever won. Make the miss say the country has no Ballon d'Or winner (a 0 value for unranked countries on this list, or a miss line driven by `noFigures`, which today only reaches validate.ts).

The ten facts are generic country trivia (the French Revolution, Portus Cale, the Soviet Union's area), not Ballon d'Or stories. Rewrite them from the Ballon d'Or page and check each: Messi won all 8 of Argentina's; Platini won three in a row (1983-85); Cruyff and van Basten won three each; Lev Yashin is the only goalkeeper to win; Kane (2026) is England's first winner since Owen (2001); Spain's 4 include Argentine-born Di Stefano and Italy's 5 include Argentine-born Sivori.

Junk redirect aliases that aren't names of the country, from the shared country lexicon: "Languages of cornwall" (England, only this puzzle), "Argentina.gob.ar" (Argentina, 21 puzzles), "German federal state" (Germany, 25 puzzles; a German federal state is a Land such as Bavaria).
